source_policy: Primary author manuscripts and official university lecture notes only. The references support methods and hypotheses, not a claim that the original equation has been solved.

sources.title: 18.783 Elliptic Curves, Lecture 2: Elliptic curves as abelian groups
sources.relevant_location: Section 2.1, the group law for Weierstrass curves
sources.actual_use: The finite-field certificate doubles the known order-three point using the ordinary short-Weierstrass formulas.
sources.not_claimed: This is not a cryptographic discrete-log attack, a computation of all rational points, or a new general group-law theorem.

sources.title: The Mordell-Weil sieve: proving non-existence of rational points on curves
sources.relevant_location: Sections 1-3, particularly finite-index subgroup and coprime-index requirements
sources.actual_use: Identifies the missing global Mordell-Weil subgroup/index input. Known points and local tables alone are not treated as a complete Mordell-Weil sieve.
sources.not_claimed: No full Mordell-Weil sieve or complete basis computation has been executed in this supplement.

sources.title: Lectures on rational points on curves
sources.relevant_location: Section 3.3, printed page 52, Hasse-Weil point-count bound
sources.actual_use: For nonsingular genus-two fibers over Fp with p>=19, p+1-4sqrt(p)>2 implies an affine point beyond the two rational points at infinity. Together with singular factorization and exact p<=17 tables this proves the stated limit of the whole-fiber mod-prime test.
sources.not_claimed: Finite-field solubility is not asserted to imply p-adic, rational, or integral solubility.

sources.title: Determining the rational points on a curve of genus 2 and Mordell-Weil rank 1
sources.relevant_location: Theorem 1.1 and Section 3, Testing for local points
sources.actual_use: Separates local integral-point obstructions from a complete rational-point algorithm that needs a point generating a finite-index subgroup of the Jacobian.
sources.not_claimed: The complete algorithm, Jacobian subgroup, Coleman integrals, and its termination conditions were not implemented or supplied here.
